newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY SEES HARVESTING TO END IN MID-AUGUST.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY SEES HARVESTING TO END IN MID-AUGUST.

text.p: Hungary's Agriculture Ministry said on Monday harvesting was expected to start around June 20 and would end in mid-August, weather permitting.

"Harvesting will probably start within a week and we expect it to end by the middle of August, if conditions are normal," Fulop Benedek, State Secretary at the Agriculture Ministry told a news conference.

He added that Hungary has between 8,500 and 9,000 combines but as two-thirds of those are older than five years and some are in disrepair the ministry expects only some 65 to 70 percent of their capacity can be used.
The ministry forecasted earlier a five million tonnes wheat crop, up from last year's 3.9 million tonnes and a 1.2 million tonnes barley crop, up from last year's 930,000 tonnes.
